disclaimer: Baselines only; no ML model has been evaluated on real data.
iiie_definition: Goessling et al. 2016: IIEE = area overestimated + underestimated at 15% threshold, weighted by cell area (m^2 from projection areal scale), exclude land/missing from both.

climatology_trend.note: Both 'climatology' (no trend) and 'climatology+trend' (linear trend) are evaluated; trend fit on training years only.

sensor_caveat: V6 uses AMSR2 from 1 Jan 2025 onward (different sensor). Held-out test block must end by 31 Dec 2024. 2025+ reported separately as different-sensor period.
